title: Style Library + Crash-Proof Continuity System v1
goal: Create separately named permanent editing-style libraries, keep only one running task in workflows/current, preserve exact visible chat/actions and resume state, checkpoint at least hourly, and synchronize evidence to GitHub, Drive, Notion, Linear and Google Docs without silent omissions.
acceptance_criteria: Every permanent editing style has its own complete named folder and knowledge index.
workflows/current contains only the single running task and an exact next action.
Refresh/restart recovery continues from a verified hash-chained checkpoint rather than restarting.
Hourly/event-driven checkpoint packages and five-platform sync ledgers exist.
Repository, tests, authorities and remote records validate without unrecorded drift.
next_action: Initialize Git with pinned vendor gitlinks, run full validation, create a committed checkpoint, then upload the repository/recovery bundle to Drive.
